identity.name: The Glass Clinic
identity.tone: Clinical Sanctuary - Professional, Transparent, Calm, Efficient
identity.description: A medical platform that balances clinical precision with human warmth. It avoids the sterile 'hospital white' by introducing soft organic textures and 'crystal glass' surfaces for depth.

rules.eyebrow: font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600;

glassmorphism.usage: Sticky headers, floating interactive cards, toast notifications

landing_page.hero: Asymmetric 'Tetris' Grid. Image right (60%), Text left (40%). Overlapping elements.
landing_page.services: Bento Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3). Cards with subtle hover lift.
landing_page.spacing: Generous. Section padding: py-24 or py-32.

dashboard.structure: Slim vertical sidebar (icon only on mobile). Top bar for search/profile.
dashboard.grid: High-density Bento Grid for widgets. Gap-6.
dashboard.cards: Flat white cards with 1px border-slate-100. No heavy shadows to reduce visual noise.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white rounded-full px-8 py-6 hover:bg-primary/90 transition-all shadow-lg hover:shadow-primary/20
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-primary border border-primary/20 rounded-full px-8 py-6 hover:bg-primary/5 transition-all

inputs.style: bg-slate-50 border-transparent focus:border-primary focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 rounded-xl h-12 px-4 transition-all

cards.marketing: bg-white rounded-2xl p-8 border border-slate-100 shadow-soft hover:shadow-float transition-all duration-500

accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure text colors meet WCAG AA against backgrounds.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2 on all interactive elements.

universal_guidelines: Do NOT use gradients for text.
Always use data-testid on interactive elements.
Dashboard charts must use 'recharts' via Shadcn Charts.
Never center text in dashboard widgets; left-align for scanability.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Install fonts in index.css. Configure tailwind.config.js with the brand colors.
instructions_to_main_agent.landing: Build a high-trust, asymmetric landing page. Use the 'Glassmorphism' style for the booking widget.
instructions_to_main_agent.dashboard: Build a high-density, clean dashboard. Prioritize data clarity over decoration.
